newsitem.title: UK: UK's MMS in Kazakh oil deal with Chaparral.
newsitem.headline: UK's MMS in Kazakh oil deal with Chaparral.

text.p: MMS Petroleum Plc, the independent oil and gas exploration company, on Wednesday said it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Chaparral Resources Inc of the U.S.,giving it a stake in an oilfield in Kazakhstan.
MMS is to pay Chaparral around $6.0 million in cash over three tranches together with 2.5 million shares in MMS.

Under the memorandum -- which gives MMS a 17.5 percent stake in the Karakuduk oilfield development project -- MMS has agreed to take a 35 percent interest in Central Asian Petroleum Guernsey Ltd, a unit of Chaparral.
MMS' interest will amount to about 22 million barrels of proven plus probable reserves. Oil sales are expected by around the end of the year.

Central Asian Petroleum holds 50 percent in Karakuduk Munay Inc, a joint stock company holding a licence to develop Karakuduk which is located 227 miles from Aktau, a port on the Caspian Sea. The other 50 percent is held by a Kazakh regional government group.
